hero.headline: Your living room is the stage
hero.subline: Open a room on the TV, share the code, and let everyone queue up songs from their phone.

step_1.title: Host opens a room on the TV
step_1.body: One tap starts a room and puts the big-screen player up.

step_2.title: Friends scan the QR
step_2.body: Guests scan the on-screen code with their phone — no app, no account.

step_3.title: Everybody queues songs
step_3.body: Anyone can search and add a song to the shared queue.

live_queue.title: Live shared queue
live_queue.body: Everyone's picks land in one queue that syncs to the TV instantly.

no_app.title: No app to install
no_app.body: Guests scan a QR code and they're in — nickname, no signup.

search.title: Karaoke-first search
search.body: YouTube search biased toward karaoke versions, or paste any link.

host_controls.title: Host stays in control
host_controls.body: Play, pause, skip, volume, and reorder from the host's phone.

reactions.title: Live reactions
reactions.body: Emoji fly up the TV as the crowd cheers, with an end-of-song recap.

avatars.title: Guest profiles
avatars.body: Photos and avatars in the lobby so everyone sees who's in the room.

cta.title: Start your first party
cta.subline: Open a room on the big screen and share the code — the queue fills itself.
